text:
anya: hey all — first day here, trying to run the starter repo pipeline in Buildkite and the docker push to ghcr.io fails with a 403. any quick pointers on what perms the CI Github App needs?

oliver: welcome! most likely missing package publish perms on the GitHub side. is the runner using a PAT or the org GitHub App?

anya: using the org GitHub App (we followed the README). buildkite job shows: 
```
# docker push output
The push refers to repository [ghcr.io/redwood-inference/starter]
unauthorized: permission denied for: packages:package_write, packages:package_read
```

zoe: yep that error usually means the app doesn't have Packages write enabled. Go to org settings -> Installed GitHub Apps -> select the app -> Repository permissions and enable "Packages: Read & write" for the repos (or org-level if you want to allow across repos).

matt: also check the app has access to the repo in the install scope. If it's an org install, you might need to toggle "All repositories" or add the specific repo.

anya: thanks — looks like the app was installed but set to only "Selected repositories" and starter wasn't added. I'll ping eng-infra to add it.

oliver: if you don't have perms to change the app, @anya open a ticket in #eng-infra with the repo name and we'll add it. For temporary workaround you can use a CR_PAT secret in Buildkite but prefer fixing the app config.

anya: filed a request: https://redwood-internal/eng-infra/requests/3211 — can someone with org admin bless? :pray:

infra-bot: Request 3211 created and assigned to oliver. ETA ~ 30m.

oliver: done — added starter repo and enabled Packages write. can you re-run the pipeline?

anya: re-ran — now it progresses past the push. One flaky test failed later but that's unrelated. Huge thanks! :tada:

zoe: sweet — welcome aboard again! ping us if you want a walkthrough of buildkite pipelines later.

matt: note for docs: we should add a quick checklist for new repos: install app, ensure Packages read/write, workflows access. I'll make a tiny PR.

anya: appreciated, will watch for that PR and add any onboarding gaps I hit.
